beats.say: Simplify log base three of five, plus log base three of six, minus log base three of ten.
All three logs have base three. Same base, so we can combine them.
Look at the first two. Plus means multiply: this is Add Power.
So log base three of five, plus log base three of six, becomes log base three of five times six.
Five times six is thirty. So we have log base three of thirty, minus log base three of ten.
Only added logs combine like this. Log five times log six is not log thirty.
Now the minus. Minus means divide: this is Minus Power.
So we get log base three of thirty over ten.
Thirty over ten is three, which leaves log base three of three.
The base matches the number inside, so the log is one. The answer is one.
